newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Forbes gets 45 mln stg to help with UK buy.
newsitem.headline: Forbes gets 45 mln stg to help with UK buy.

text.p: South Africa's Forbes Group Ltd said on Thursday it had raised about 45 million stg in an international share placement to help fund a recent British acquisition.
Earlier this month Forbes made a recommended cash offer of 185 cents a share for British marine insurance firm Nelson Hurst Plc that valued it at 84 million stg.
Forbes, a leading provider of risk management, insurance and employee benefits related services in South Africa, already owned 9.94 percent of Nelson Hurst.

Forbes said it had privately placed 45.5 million shares with international investors at 780 cents a share, a 10 percent discount to the weighted average traded price of Forbes during the 30 trading days before July 15.
The offer was underwritten by Merrill Lynch International, Robert Fleming & Co Ltd and RMB International.
